description: Classify the two abuse-reports errors so the runtime can act on them. Both are wire code 7003 — a malformed or unroutable request — so they are BadRequestError: caller-fixable, and explicitly NOT transient, so the default retry policy leaves them alone. Without a category a generated error is invisible to `isTransientError` and to every other `Category.*` check, and because the protocol matches per-operation error codes BEFORE falling back to HTTP-status classes, a code-matched error shadows the categorized class it would otherwise have become.
